cards.subject: One vale
lines: This is one enormous zone running roughly thirty to forty-five, top to bottom, and it was one of the first places conceived for the game — the concept art the rest of the look was built from.
Cataclysm cuts it in half at a whirlpool. Northern Stranglethorn one side, the Cape the other.

cards.subject: An empire killed itself here
lines: Gurubashi priests summoned Hakkar the Soulflayer and the empire tore itself apart in civil war. The Zandalari came and put him down.
The surviving Hakkari fled north and built the Temple of Atal'Hakkar in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Everything overgrown in this jungle is that empire's wreckage.

cards.subject: Colonel Conrad Kurzen
cards.tag: Stormwind sent a good soldier in
lines: He did not come back right. The ogre mage Mai'Zoth got into his head and turned the whole expedition into Mai'Zoth's army.
The Rebel Camp is his own men — the ones who refused.
He is Colonel Kurtz. The first name is Joseph Conrad. He is waiting at the bottom of the Stockpile.

cards.subject: Hemet Nesingwary
lines: An anagram of Ernest Hemingway, and the whole camp is Green Hills of Africa: the great white hunter, the tally, the clients, the servant.
Ajeck Rouack, Sir S. J. Erlgadin, Barnil Stonepot.
In here the dwarf running it is Hemet Nesingwary Jr. His father's career had not been written yet.

cards.subject: The pages are his memoir
lines: What you grind out of the jungle is Hemet's own hunting book, handed in to Barnil Stonepot in four chapters.
The reward is a pair of boots, three potions and two armour kits.
The book runs to thirty pages. You never find most of it.

cards.subject: The white tiger
cards.tag: In the manuscript, and on the hill
lines: In Hemet's book, a mysterious white tiger saves the expedition from certain death.
The trophy kill at the end of the tiger hunt is King Bangalash, a white tiger.
Nothing in the game ever says they are the same animal.

cards.subject: The battleground under the arena
lines: Blizzard built a five-versus-five deathmatch map called the Gurubashi Catacombs down there — where the trolls kept the beasts.
It died: the map was too large to find anyone in, and casters died too fast to fix without rewriting classes.
They wrote down six lessons from it. Those lessons became the Arena system.

cards.subject: The chest drops on a clock
cards.tag: Every three hours from server midnight
lines: Inside the arena floor everyone is flagged — free for all, any faction, on any realm type, including the peaceful ones.
The Arena Master trinket is always in the chest.
Twelve of them handed to Short John Mithril buys the Arena Grand Master.

cards.subject: The south still bites
lines: Both were full of elite mobs at launch, and both had the tag stripped in patch 2.3.0, two years later.
In here they still have it.
Under the ogre mound there is a shrine. They are squatting in a temple.

cards.subject: Blackwater Cove
lines: It was a small human port, and the jungle trolls overran it. The Steamwheedle goblins drove the trolls out and kept the harbour.
Baron Revilgaz's outfit is still called the Blackwater Raiders.
The new owners are wearing the old town's name.

cards.subject: Janeiro's Point
lines: A giant goblin with its arms spread, welcoming ships in. Nobody knows which goblin.
It is Christ the Redeemer, and the name is Rio de Janeiro.
In the game's alpha the statue was a human. Somebody made it a goblin before launch.

cards.subject: The choice you cannot unmake
lines: There is exactly one way to gain standing with the pirates: murder the citizens of Booty Bay.
Every kill costs full standing there and half as much in Ratchet, Gadgetzan and Everlook — all four goblin towns at once.
There is no practical way back. The prize is a hat.

cards.subject: The Fishing Extravaganza
lines: Riggle Bassbait sets up on the Booty Bay docks. Forty Speckled Tastyfish, and the fish only exist during those two hours — you cannot bank them in advance.
In here exactly one angler wins: the first to hand in.
An Arcanite Fishing Pole, or the Hook of the Master Angler.
